name: Uncraft Kit
summary: Craft wool, quartz, clay, glowstone, ice and other packed blocks back into the pieces you made them from.
logoPrompt: A crafting table with a quartz block on top splitting apart into four shiny white quartz crystals, a few loose curls of string lying beside it, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: Undo the block you crafted too soon.

description: **Uncraft Kit adds crafting recipes that turn packed blocks back into their materials, for when you made one too many.**
- Wool of all 16 colours gives 4 string.
- Quartz blocks, pillars and chiseled quartz give 4 nether quartz each.
- Clay, snow, glowstone, amethyst, bricks, nether bricks, honeycomb blocks and resin bricks give back their 4 pieces.
- Blue ice gives 9 packed ice, packed ice 9 ice and a dripstone block 4 pointed dripstone.
- Amounts match the vanilla recipes: never more than went in.
Import the .mcpack, then turn it on under Behavior Packs when you create or edit a world. Put one block alone into a crafting grid; the recipe book shows each recipe once you carry its block.
- Made for Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 and newer. It only adds recipes, so it is safe to add to or remove from a world.
- Hay bales, slime and iron blocks already come apart in vanilla and stay as they are.
- Like every behavior pack, it turns off achievements in the world it is added to.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
